claim_text: Wet-season rainfall over the central Sahel has increased
product: GPM_3IMERGM (GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07 (GPM_3IMERGM))
product_label: GPM IMERG Final V07 monthly rainfall, 0.5° cells (block mean of 0.1°)

baseline.text: mean of each cell's 2001–2025 season averages

choices.baseline: Each cell's own full-period mean (2001–2025); months use that calendar month's mean over the same years.
choices.season_rule: Season mean needs at least 3 of 4 valid months.
choices.cell_rule: Cells kept if at least 60% of years are valid and inside the support mask (if the case has one).
choices.aggregation: Native 0.1° cells block-averaged by 5 (needs 50% valid sub-cells) to 0.5° for display.
choices.regional: Area-weighted (cos latitude), native grid, season needs 80% of support cells valid; months 50%.
choices.scale: Symmetric about zero; 98th percentile of |cell anomaly| rounded up. Values beyond are drawn at the end colour.
choices.land_mask: none: every cell of the case grid is drawn
choices.claims: Descriptive display only. No trend, test or verdict is computed or altered here.
